reasons.correctness: Entity field, display_order INT NOT NULL DEFAULT 0 and both mappings are in place; 4/4 hidden tests pass. The seed gives PLN 0, EUR 1, USD 2, but every other currency defaults to 0 and ties with PLN.
reasons.convention_fit: The changeset name, header, rollback and changelog.xml include with its month comment follow the convention. The unit tests were added to existing CurrencyServiceUnitTest instead of a new *UnitTest class, as the convention requires.
reasons.design_fit: A minimal additive change in the currency package. It extends the existing duplicated builder mapping in CurrencyController instead of routing through the service mapping, which keeps a pre-existing smell alive.
reasons.test_quality: The new assertions only check the entity constructor and DTO getters and setters. No test exercises CurrencyService.toDto or getDataPagedAndFilteredAsDtos, so the displayOrder mapping is not pinned.
reasons.graph_use: One graph query found the currency files before editing. Changelog discovery, locating the display-order example changeset and finding constructor callers relied on ls, grep and find.
